request.text: One night I was up late scrolling a GLP-1 support group on Facebook, and a woman posted that she'd been backed up for months on Ozempic until she started using three specific ingredients together. First was apigenin from celery juice, which she said has been shown to activate the receptors in the gut wall that trigger those contractions. Second was chlorophyllin, a plant compound that binds gas-producing compounds before they build pressure. Third was a soluble prebiotic fiber, and she was specific about the type. The bulk kind in most fiber powders and gummies just piles up in a gut that's already slowed down, which is exactly why mine made things worse. She said that's why MiraLAX never stuck for her either. It's just pushing stuff out. This is actually getting the muscle to start moving again on its own. She'd been on the shot for a year and said it was the only thing that ever worked. She'd finally stopped dreading meals. I almost kept scrolling because I'd tried the celery juice thing back in 2019 and felt nothing. But she said it doesn't work on its own. You need all three together in the right ratio.
